title: pdf-ingest-1: image installs pypdf and reportlab, portable behind the proxy

goal.statement: The image builds on a normal machine and behind the proxy, with pinned pypdf and reportlab importable in the test service and no machine-specific value committed.

title: pdf-ingest-2: a PDF Email in the Mailbox becomes a Message with a Source

goal.statement: A directory of real .eml and .pdf files loads into Messages with Source and a Skipped File count, and the Digest treats PDF Messages exactly like .eml ones, malformed, encrypted and header-less PDFs being skipped without raising.

title: pdf-ingest-3: Source and Skipped Files in /api/digest and on the page

goal.statement: GET /api/digest shows source on each Message and the skipped count, and GET / shows an escaped PDF/EML badge and a skipped line only when above zero.

title: pdf-ingest-4: reproducible sample PDF Emails on the three sample days

goal.statement: Three committed sample PDF Emails, one a reply in an existing Thread, are reproduced byte for byte by a committed script and give the expected Digest totals on each of the three days.

title: pdf-ingest-5: integration test counts the sample PDFs in the 2025-03-10 total

goal.statement: The HTTP seam test for 2025-03-10 expects the Digest total that includes the sample PDF Email (5).

title: pdf-ingest-6: build check proves proxy wiring and builds with the machine's own CA_BUNDLE_DIR

goal.statement: scripts/build_check.sh proves the compose wiring with empty defaults and builds the image with whatever CA_BUNDLE_DIR the machine provides, naming no machine path.

title: web image installs only requirements.txt, test image also installs requirements-test.txt

goal.statement: reportlab, the test-only PDF writer, is pinned in requirements-test.txt and installed only in the test image, so the web image ships pypdf alone.

verification.command: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm test python -c 'import pypdf, reportlab' && ! docker compose run --rm web python -c 'import reportlab'
